title: tsconfig + vitest Isolation
description:
tsconfig + vitest Isolation

- Add "src/dashboard/**" to vitest.config.ts coverage.exclude array
- Add "src/dashboard/node_modules" and "src/dashboard/dist" to .gitignore
- Create tests/config/isolation.test.ts: verify tsconfig exclude contains "src/dashboard"
- Verify: tsc --noEmit still clean, vitest run still passes (799 tests)
